method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reconstruction of the sort discipline and its first-order embedding, verification of both displayed translations, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Many-sorted domains, sorted variables, quantifiers, identity, functions and relations; a two-sort example; and reduction to one-sorted first-order logic with completeness preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Unlike ordinary first-order logic, a many-sorted system has several disjoint domains. Each sort identifies the domain an object inhabits and has its own variables, quantifiers and usually identity; function and relation arguments also carry sort constraints, while the ordinary first-order rules are replicated by sort.
samples.checks: The disjoint-domain motivation, all four example domains, per-sort syntax, typing of arguments and repetition of quantifier rules are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The example uses separate French- and German-citizen sorts, sort-specific unary relations and a cross-sort marriage relation. The formula says that every French-German married pair has a wine-drinking French member or a German member who does not eat wurst.
samples.checks: The order of relation arguments, variable-sort assignments, implication and disjunction with negation are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The system embeds into first-order logic by pooling the domains, marking sorts with unary predicates and restricting quantifiers. Additional axioms separate the sorts and enforce relation domains. Sentences, derivations and structures translate in both directions, yielding completeness for many-sorted logic.
samples.checks: The unary-predicate encoding, relativized universal formula, disjointness axiom, typing axioms, syntactic and semantic translations, converse direction and completeness conclusion are retained.

source_observations: All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match the frozen source exactly.
